summary: vitePreprocess() does not preprocess TypeScript in v7; TS is stripped by the Svelte compiler, which rejects enum, decorators, constructor parameter properties and namespaces, so the config looks like TS support but is not
evidence: svelte.config.js:4; vite-plugin-svelte preprocess.js:30 script hook off without script:true; svelte remove_typescript_nodes.js:41,111,115,174
failure_scenario: Adding enum to a lang=ts script fails the build with typescript_invalid_feature. Fix would be script:true when needed.
resolution_note: Accepted per owner rule 2026-11-18: low and info findings are not fixed in this round; recorded in docs/status/audit.md.
